skill.descEnRank5:
Basic Attack
Deal Spectro DMG equal to 200.00% of the active Resonator's ATK.

Core Skill
Phoebe Cube prays devoutly to the Sentinel and summons Holy Light that continuously attacks the nearby targets, dealing Spectro DMG equal to 560.00% of the active Resonator's ATK per second and consistently granting all nearby Resonators in the team a Shield based on 30% of the caster's Max HP. This effect lasts for 1s. Skill Cooldown: 12s
 
Enhanced Effect
Skill Duration Level 2/4/6/8: Holy Light duration is increased by 2/4/6/8s.
